candidates.title: 'Ah! Vous dirai-je, Maman' Variations, Op.161 for Four Violins - Charles Dancla
candidates.description:
We might be apart, but we are still making wonderful music together! Enjoy this lovely version of 'Ah! Vous dirai-je, Maman' by Charles Dancla with Ann Holtzapffel, Rebecca Seymour, Brenda Sullivan, and Sonia Wilson. It's a theme and variation on a very familiar piece of music! 🌟

https://www.qso.com.au
